title: Generic artifact schema
description: Base schema for all artifacts validated by the deterministic orchestration harness. Methodology-specific artifact schemas in schemas/ extend this base via a top-level $ref (structural base, per the GSM convention; allOf is reserved for if/then facets). The harness is agnostic to the methodology that owns the artifact; this base only supplies the generic object shape and the one universal identity field (slug).

slug.description: URL-safe, human-identifying slug for the artifact — the ONE generic display/identity field every artifact schema should rely on rather than locally re-defining an equivalent 'title' property.

sources.description: Derivation provenance: workspace-relative refs to the upstream artifacts this artifact was BUILT FROM (the inputs the authoring step read). Owned by the derived artifact — the upstream cannot know its future consumers. Optional: originating artifacts (e.g. the root of the hierarchy) have no sources. Methodology-specific subtype schemas MAY narrow items with a pattern constraining which artifact kinds are valid sources (e.g. an ADR sources features). Factual only — distinct from work_item_relations (semantic peer relations).
